The '''mission to Ord Radama''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the planet [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Var will likely go to Ord Radama, the closest Imperial stronghold, which also happens to be his homeworld. You must leave immediately and catch him before he reveals this base or harms Setenna.|[[Urel Haydon]]|<ref name="OAA" />}}
After the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]], which saw the destruction of their [[Arda Base|base]] on [[Arda I]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] settled on a [[Resolute Base|new base]] on [[Jagomir]]. There, [[Var Narek]] was exposed as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and a traitor to the Alliance. He consecutively [[Kidnapping of Setenna Hase|kidnapped]] [[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] [[Setenna Hase]], a valuable Alliance leader, and fled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard a [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000]] to reach [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama's]] capital city of [[Livien Magnus]] so that she could be interrogated by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="OAA" />

==From Jagomir to Ord Radama==
[[File:Interdicted-FFG.png|thumb|left|250px|The Rebels escape from the ''Eternal Wrath'']]
Fortunately for the Rebels, due to the anomalies of the [[Jaga's Cluster/Legends|Jaga's Cluster]], the journey from Jagomir to Ord Radama took approximately two days. In order to catch up to Narek, the Rebels used a little-known route given by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Danel Qurno]] which shaved half a day from the trip.<ref name="OAA" />

However, this route wasn't without problems as it had its own travel hazards and intersected with the [[Daragon Trail]], a heavily patrolled Imperial [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]]. The Rebels exited from Jagomir and embarked in a series of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps. They took along a circuitous path through the [[Lorattick Nebula/Legends|Lorattick Nebula]] and dangerously close to [[XV-344H]], a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]]. The last part of their trip was along the Daragon Trail, which was patrolled by the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Eternal Wrath]]''. They successfully avoided the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and landed safely on Ord Radama.<ref name="OAA" />

==Ord Radama==
The Rebels arrived on Ord Radama before Narek and first went to the [[Livien Magnus spaceport]]. There, the officials of the [[Ord Radama Spaceport Authority]] revealed that no JumpMaster 5000 had docked in the past two days, confirming that Narek had not yet reached the planet.<ref name="OAA" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It is possible for players to run into the ''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer ''Eternal Wrath'' on their journey along the Daragon Trail, but only if they fail to make a specified course correction. If they do, they must persuade the ship's crew to let them pass despite having outdated access codes, otherwise [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wellam Adarios]] calls for them to be brought aboard for questioning and sends [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] to destroy them if they try to escape. This article assumes that players were successful and so did not encounter the Star Destroyer.
